jamie: heads up — samplekit sample-flow hitting structured output parse error in the JS SDK when using JSON mode + function_call. Works in Python. Repro steps below.

jamie: repro (JS):
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-instruct-1.0',
  jsonMode: true,
  function_call: { name: 'create_ticket', arguments_schema: ticketSchema },
  input: userPrompt
})
```

sasha: can you paste exact model + SDK versions? we had a parity fix last month.

jamie: js@2.3.1, py@1.9.0, model rwd-instruct-1.0. log shows the JS path sends a string in the retry wrapper: `"{\"title\":\"Bug\",\"desc\":\"...\"}"` instead of an object. python send is object.

kevin: this smells like the retry-wrapper double-encode we saw in 2.2.x. quick patch is to avoid the high-level retry for function_call helpers (or to parse before retry). opened PR with fix branch.

marta: also noticed samplekit default schema in the sample app is an array fallback (`type: ["array","object"]`) which masks some shape issues. surprising for a ticket create helper — should be object-only.

jamie: confirming: with retries on, js SDK wraps the tool response as `string` -> retry -> stringified again, so final content becomes double-encoded JSON. Python path parses earlier. attaching small trace: <link-to-gist>

devex-bot: CI: samplekit-async-tests flake on node12-compat, see https://ci.internal/runs/4521 (auto-report)

sasha: i'll take this. can we add an integration test in samplekit that runs the helper and asserts `typeof parsed === 'object'` and that parse errors are surfaced (no fallback to array)?

kevin: @sasha i can push the fix and test today. plan: parse responses before retry, tighten sample app schema to `type: object`, and add a short note in SDK doc about `jsonMode` + `function_call` parity.

jamie: suggested docs blurb: "When using JSON mode with function_call and SDK helpers, either disable the high-level retry wrapper or enable `parseBeforeRetry: true` to avoid double-encoding; ensure helper schema is object-shaped to prevent permissive fallbacks."

marta: :thumbsup: labeling this thread `devex:fncall-json` and moving to triage.

kevin: PRs: fix + test incoming, will ping when green.

jamie: thanks all, will re-run sample flow after green build and report back.
